entities.summary: Ngawang Lobzang Thupstan Chognor, commonly known as 19th Kushok Bakula Rinpoche was an Indian Buddhist lama, who also served as India's ambassador to Mongolia. He is mainly known for his efforts in reviving Buddhism in Mongolia and Russia by linking them with the community of Tibetan exiles in India.
